natsEmail.title: External form emails can't be sent yet
natsEmail.body: The NATS notification worker emails external form links using this tenant's NATS_SMTP_* configuration variables. Add them with Configure NATS.
natsEmail.waiting: Emails waiting to send: {{count}}. They go out automatically once the required variables are set.
natsEmail.unreadable: These variables can't be read (blank, or the encryption key changed):

page.title: NATS email settings
page.subtitle: SMTP settings the NATS notification worker uses to email external form links. Each value is saved as a sensitive configuration variable (in Vault when enabled) and can't be viewed after saving.
page.keepHint: Leave blank to keep the saved value.
page.nothingToSave: Enter at least one value to save.
page.readOnly: Your role can view these settings but cannot change them.

errors.load: Could not load NATS email settings.

validation.host: Enter a host name such as smtp.example.com, without a scheme or port.
validation.email: Enter an email address such as noreply@example.com.

port.label: Port
port.help: Defaults to 587. Usually 587 with STARTTLS, or 465 with SSL.

starttls.label: Use STARTTLS
starttls.help: Most servers on port 587 need this.

ssl.label: Use SSL
ssl.help: For servers that expect TLS from the start, usually on port 465.

fromEmail.label: From address
fromEmail.help: The sender of external form emails.

username.label: Username
username.help: Leave blank if the server does not need a sign-in.

namedValues.title: Configuration variables
namedValues.subtitle: Tenant-scoped values used to configure processes and connectors.
namedValues.empty: No configuration variables have been created for this tenant.
namedValues.name: Name
namedValues.sensitiveHelp: Sensitive values are stored in the configured secret provider and can never be viewed after saving.
namedValues.standardHelp: Standard values are stored with tenant configuration metadata and can be viewed while editing.
namedValues.valueKeep: Leave blank to keep the saved value. The current sensitive value cannot be displayed.
namedValues.deleteDescription: Delete "{{name}}"? Any processes or connector settings using it may stop working.
namedValues.notAllowedBody: Your permissions do not allow this configuration variable action.

validation.valueRequired: Enter a value. A new value is required when changing sensitivity.
